ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 0.20:1 high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark gray/black background pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of small, high-contrast circular white blobs across the entire visible 2D surface of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central indentation with an estimated internal angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep along the trailing edge boundaries terminating in acute upward-tilted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme dense clustering of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle attachments) covering >85% of the visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Total surface saturation of epibiotic barnacle colonization creating a heterogeneous textured appearance and altered edge profiles at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive clumps of high-intensity pixel clusters protruding from the trailing edge and distal tips.
